```{r output-helpers, include=FALSE}
save_csv <- function(x, filename) {
  write.csv(
    x,
    file.path(output_dir, filename),
    row.names = FALSE,
    na = ""
  )
}

show_table <- function(x, caption, digits = 4, col.names = names(x)) {
  tab <- knitr::kable(
    x, format = "latex", caption = caption, label = NA, position = "H",
    digits = digits, row.names = FALSE, col.names = col.names
  )
  cat("\n\n```{=latex}\n", as.character(tab), "\n```\n\n", sep = "")
}

make_anova_table <- function(model) {
  a <- as.data.frame(anova(model))

  data.frame(
    Term = rownames(a),
    a,
    row.names = NULL,
    check.names = FALSE
  )
}
```

## Research question

How do mowing schedules affect total weed biomass at broccoli harvest,
and how do the planted treatments compare with the weedy control?

- **T1** was the unplanted weedy control. One control plot was mown after pre-transplant sampling.
- **T2:** mowing at 1 week before transplanting and at 3 and 6 weeks
  after transplanting.
- **T3:** mowing at 1 week before transplanting and at 6 weeks
  after transplanting.
- **T4:** mowing at 1 week before transplanting only.

Total weed biomass combines identified and unidentified weeds, including
UNKNOWN MONOCOTS, UNKNOWN DICOTS and UNKNOWN BRASSICA. TRFRE is a weed.
CLOVER identifies volunteer clover. TRFAL identifies sown berseem clover,
and RYE and CEREAL RYE identify sown cereal rye. Volunteer and sown
biomass are summarized separately.

## Sampling and statistical methods

- **Broccoli rows (intrarow).** In T2–T4, two 0.28 m² quadrats per plot were cut at ground level.
- **Living-mulch strips (interrow).** In T2–T4, two 0.16 m² quadrats per plot were cut at 8 cm.
- **Weedy control (T1).** Four 0.16 m² quadrats per plot were cut at 8 cm.

Weed masses are summed within each observed quadrat and divided
by quadrat area. Quadrat densities are averaged within each plot
and sampling location. Two dry weighings of unidentified monocots from block 4,
T4, interrow quadrat 2 were combined (1.34 g + 0.07 g = 1.41 g).

The plot is the experimental unit. The intrarow model uses 12 plot means
from T2–T4. The interrow and control model uses 16 plot means from T1–T4.
Each model includes treatment and block as categorical fixed effects.
Tukey-adjusted comparisons cover all treatment pairs within each model.

Comparisons among T2–T4 evaluate mowing schedules. Comparisons with T1
also reflect the difference in planting. The intrarow results section
shows the four T1 plots separately as a descriptive reference.

## Sampling checks

```{r analysis-settings, include=FALSE}
# Output folder.
output_dir <- file.path(getwd(), "Weed Biomass")
dir.create(output_dir, recursive = TRUE, showWarnings = FALSE)

# Treatment order, labels and colours.
treatment_levels <- c("T1", "T4", "T3", "T2")

treatment_labels <- c(
  T1 = "T1\nWeedy control",
  T4 = "T4\n-1 week",
  T3 = "T3\n-1 and +6 weeks",
  T2 = "T2\n-1, +3 and +6 weeks"
)

treatment_colours <- c(
  T1 = "#777777",
  T4 = "#A56A46",
  T3 = "#4B8395",
  T2 = "#4A8862"
)

locations <- c("Broccoli", "Cover crop")
```

```{r download-workbook, include=FALSE}
# Download the workbook from GitHub: 2-Data/Raw/.
github_url <- paste0(
  "https://raw.githubusercontent.com/Pr1nc3sso/",
  "Xilei-Living-cover-crop/master/2-Data/Raw/",
  "Vegetation%20survey%20-%20broccoli%20harvest.xlsx"
)

options(timeout = max(120, getOption("timeout", 60)))
excel_file <- tempfile(fileext = ".xlsx")

download.file(
  github_url,
  excel_file,
  mode = "wb",
  method = "libcurl",
  quiet = TRUE
)
downloaded_at_utc <- format(Sys.time(), tz = "UTC")
```

```{r read-workbook, include=FALSE}
raw <- read_excel(
  excel_file,
  sheet = "2026",
  range = cell_cols("A:J"),
  col_types = "text",
  trim_ws = FALSE
)

expected_headers <- c(
  "Biomass collection date",
  "Weeks after transplanting",
  "Block",
  "Treatment",
  "Quadrat",
  "Relative location to Broccoli: in row or in cover crop",
  "Species",
  "Biomass weight without bags, scale tared (gram)",
  "Quadrat size (m2)",
  "Weight date"
)

if (!identical(names(raw), expected_headers)) {
  stop("Excel headers changed. Check the column mapping.")
}
```

```{r check-duplicate-rows, include=FALSE}
# Track row numbers from the worksheet before filtering.
source_rows <- raw
source_rows$excel_row <- seq_len(nrow(raw)) + 1L
source_rows <- source_rows[rowSums(!is.na(raw[1:10])) > 0, ]

# Remove only exact duplicates across the original ten columns.
duplicate_flag <- duplicated(as.data.frame(source_rows[1:10]))

save_csv(
  source_rows[duplicate_flag, ],
  "removed_exact_duplicates.csv"
)

unique_records <- source_rows[!duplicate_flag, ]

names(unique_records)[1:10] <- c(
  "collection_date",
  "weeks_after_transplanting",
  "block",
  "treatment",
  "quadrat",
  "location",
  "species",
  "weight_g",
  "source_area_m2",
  "weighing_date"
)

knitr::kable(
  data.frame(
    "Nonempty rows" = nrow(source_rows),
    "Exact duplicates" = sum(duplicate_flag),
    "Retained rows" = nrow(unique_records),
    check.names = FALSE
  ),
  caption = "Worksheet rows before and after exact duplicate removal."
)
```

```{r standardize-fields, include=FALSE}
clean <- unique_records %>%
  mutate(
    across(
      c(block, treatment, quadrat, weight_g, source_area_m2),
      as.numeric
    ),
    source_location = location,
    source_species = species,
    location = trimws(gsub("[[:space:]]+", " ", location)),
    species = toupper(trimws(gsub("[[:space:]]+", " ", species))),
    species = recode(
      species,
      "UNKNOWNN MONOCOTS" = "UNKNOWN MONOCOTS",
      "UNKNOWNN DICOTS" = "UNKNOWN DICOTS"
    ),
    # All T1 quadrats follow the cover-crop-area sampling protocol.
    location = if_else(treatment == 1, "Cover crop", location)
  )
```

```{r validate-fields, include=FALSE}
# Validate identifiers and weights.
numeric_fields <- c(
  "block", "treatment", "quadrat", "weight_g"
)

if (any(!is.finite(as.matrix(clean[numeric_fields])))) {
  stop("Missing or invalid identifiers or weights.")
}

if (any(clean$weight_g < 0)) {
  stop("Negative biomass weights.")
}

if (
  any(!clean$block %in% 1:4) ||
  any(!clean$treatment %in% 1:4) ||
  any(!clean$quadrat %in% 1:4) ||
  any(!clean$location %in% locations)
) {
  stop("Unexpected block, treatment, quadrat or location.")
}

if (any(is.na(clean$species) | clean$species == "")) {
  stop("Missing species labels.")
}
```

```{r combine-split-weighings, include=FALSE}
# Harvest sheet "2026", collected September 11. Both portions belong to the
# same B4/T4 interrow quadrat and species group.
weighed_records <- mutate(clean, source_weight_g = weight_g)
harvest_day <- as.Date("2026-09-11")
excel_day <- as.character(as.integer(harvest_day - as.Date("1899-12-30")))
target <- which(with(weighed_records,
  collection_date %in% c(as.character(harvest_day), excel_day) &
    block == 4 & treatment == 4 & location == "Cover crop" &
    quadrat == 2 & species == "UNKNOWN MONOCOTS"
))

# Field weighings: 1.34 g on September 25 and 0.07 g on October 7.
portions <- c(1.34, 0.07)
combined <- sum(portions)
recorded <- weighed_records$source_weight_g[target]
if (length(target) == 1L && any(near(recorded, c(portions, combined)))) {
  weighed_records$weight_g[target] <- combined
} else if (!(length(target) == 2L && all(near(sort(recorded), sort(portions))))) {
  stop("Check the B4/T4 interrow quadrat 2 unknown-monocot weights in the harvest workbook.")
}

save_csv(
  select(weighed_records[target, ], excel_row, collection_date, weighing_date,
         block, treatment, location, quadrat, species, source_weight_g, weight_g),
  "split_weighing_audit.csv"
)
```

```{r apply-sampling-protocol, include=FALSE}
area_records <- weighed_records %>%
  mutate(area_m2 = if_else(location == "Broccoli", 0.28, 0.16))

area_records %>%
  count(source_location, location, source_area_m2, area_m2, name = "Records") %>%
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Field location", "Analysis location", "Field area", "Analysis area", "Records"),
    caption = "Worksheet and analysis locations and quadrat areas (square metres)."
  )
```

```{r classify-species, include=FALSE}
# Explicit classification of the currently recorded weed codes.
weed_species <- c(
  "AMARE", "ARTVU", "CAPBP", "CHEAL", "DIGIS", "DIGSA",
  "ECHCG", "GASCI", "LACSE", "MALNE", "MEDLU", "OXASD",
  "OXAST", "PLANA", "POLLA", "POLPE", "POROL", "SETSP",
  "SETPU", "SETVI", "TRFRE", "UNKNOWN MONOCOTS"
)
berseem_codes <- c("TRFAL", "BERSEEM CLOVER", "BERSEEM", "TRIFOLIUM ALEXANDRINUM")
rye_codes <- c("RYE", "CEREAL RYE", "SECALE CEREALE", "SECCE")
volunteer_codes <- c("CLOVER", "VOLUNTEER CLOVER")

analysis_records <- area_records %>%
  mutate(
    is_unknown_weed = grepl("^UNKNOWN($| )", species),
    component = case_when(
      species %in% c(berseem_codes, rye_codes) ~ "Cover crop",
      species %in% volunteer_codes ~ "Volunteer",
      species %in% weed_species | is_unknown_weed ~ "Weeds",
      TRUE ~ "Unmapped"
    ),
    species_label = case_when(
      species %in% berseem_codes ~ "Berseem clover",
      species %in% rye_codes ~ "Cereal rye",
      species %in% volunteer_codes ~ "Volunteer clover",
      TRUE ~ species
    )
  )

analysis_records %>%
  group_by(component) %>%
  summarise(codes = n_distinct(species), records = n(), .groups = "drop") %>%
  knitr::kable(
    col.names = c("Component", "Species codes", "Records"),
    caption = "Species codes and worksheet records by biomass component."
  )
```

```{r check-species-mapping, include=FALSE}
save_csv(

  save_csv(

}
```

```{r check-quadrat-dates, include=FALSE}
# Avoid combining different collection dates within a quadrat.
date_check <- analysis_records %>%
  group_by(block, treatment, location, quadrat) %>%
  summarise(
    n_dates = n_distinct(collection_date, na.rm = TRUE),
    n_missing_dates = sum(
      is.na(collection_date) | trimws(collection_date) == ""
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  )

if (any(date_check$n_dates != 1L | date_check$n_missing_dates > 0L)) {
  stop("Missing or multiple collection dates within quadrats.")
}
```

```{r sum-quadrat-masses, include=FALSE}
# Aggregate all observed quadrats before selecting biomass components.
quadrat_mass <- analysis_records %>%
  group_by(block, treatment, location, quadrat) %>%
  summarise(
    area_m2 = first(area_m2),
    identified_weed_g = sum(
      weight_g[component == "Weeds" & !is_unknown_weed]
    ),
    unknown_weed_g = sum(
      weight_g[component == "Weeds" & is_unknown_weed]
    ),
    volunteer_g = sum(weight_g[component == "Volunteer"]),
    n_cover_crop_records = sum(component == "Cover crop"),
    recorded_cover_crop_g = if (any(component == "Cover crop")) {
      sum(weight_g[component == "Cover crop"])
    } else {
      NA_real_
    },
    recorded_total_g = sum(weight_g),
    .groups = "drop"
  )
```

```{r calculate-quadrat-densities, include=FALSE}
quadrat_data <- quadrat_mass %>%
  mutate(
    identified_weed_g_m2 = identified_weed_g / area_m2,
    unknown_weed_g_m2 = unknown_weed_g / area_m2,
    volunteer_g_m2 = volunteer_g / area_m2,

    # Include unknown weeds; exclude volunteers and sown cover crops.
    weed_g_m2 = (identified_weed_g + unknown_weed_g) / area_m2,

    recorded_cover_crop_g_m2 = recorded_cover_crop_g / area_m2,
    recorded_total_g_m2 = recorded_total_g / area_m2
  )

quadrat_data %>%
  filter(block == 1, treatment == 2) %>%
  select(location, quadrat, area_m2, identified_weed_g, unknown_weed_g, weed_g_m2) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    digits = 2,
    col.names = c("Location", "Quadrat", "Area (m2)", "Identified (g)", "Unknown (g)", "Weeds (g/m2)"),
    caption = "Block 1, T2. Weed masses and densities for each quadrat."
  )
```

```{r calculate-plot-means, include=FALSE}
# One mean per experimental plot and sampling location.
plot_data <- quadrat_data %>%
  group_by(block, treatment, location) %>%
  summarise(
    n_quadrats = n(),
    across(
      c(
        identified_weed_g_m2,
        unknown_weed_g_m2,
        volunteer_g_m2,
        weed_g_m2,
        recorded_total_g_m2
      ),
      mean
    ),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    block = factor(
      paste0("B", block),
      levels = paste0("B", 1:4)
    ),
    treatment = factor(
      paste0("T", treatment),
      levels = treatment_levels
    )
  )

if (
  any(
    plot_data$n_quadrats !=
      ifelse(plot_data$treatment == "T1", 4L, 2L)
  )
) {
  stop("Expected four quadrats for T1 and two per location for T2-T4.")
}

plot_data %>%
  filter(block == "B1", treatment == "T2") %>%
  select(location, n_quadrats, weed_g_m2) %>%
  knitr::kable(
    digits = 2,
    col.names = c("Location", "Quadrats", "Mean weeds (g/m2)"),
    caption = "Block 1, T2. Plot means from the quadrat densities above."
  )
```

## Weed biomass models

```{r weed-model-functions, include=FALSE}
fit_tables <- function(d, response) {
  fit <- lm(
    reformulate(c("treatment", "block"), response = response),
    data = d,
    na.action = na.fail
  )

  emm <- emmeans(fit, ~ treatment, weights = "equal")

  list(
    fit = fit,
    anova = make_anova_table(fit),
    means = as.data.frame(
      confint(emm, level = 0.95)
    ),
    tukey = as.data.frame(
      summary(
        pairs(emm, adjust = "tukey"),
        infer = c(TRUE, TRUE),
        level = 0.95
      )
    )
  )
}
```

```{r weed-model-inputs, include=FALSE}
model_data <- setNames(lapply(locations, function(loc) {
  d <- droplevels(filter(plot_data, location == loc))
  treatments <- if (loc == "Broccoli") c("T2", "T3", "T4") else paste0("T", 1:4)
  stopifnot(
    setequal(as.character(d$treatment), treatments),
    setequal(as.character(d$block), paste0("B", 1:4)),
    all(table(d$block, d$treatment) == 1L)
  )
  d
}), locations)

knitr::kable(data.frame(
  Location = locations,
  Plot_means = vapply(model_data, nrow, integer(1)),
  Treatments = vapply(model_data, function(d) nlevels(d$treatment), integer(1))
), row.names = FALSE, caption = "Plot means available to each model")
```

```{r weed-primary-models}
primary_models <- lapply(model_data, fit_tables, response = "weed_g_m2")
model_check <- data.frame(
  Location = locations,
  Residual_df = vapply(primary_models, function(x) df.residual(x$fit), numeric(1)),
  Tukey_pairs = vapply(primary_models, function(x) nrow(x$tukey), integer(1))
)
knitr::kable(model_check, row.names = FALSE, caption = "Primary model checks", position = "H")
```

```{r weed-log-models, include=FALSE}
log_models <- lapply(model_data, function(d) {
  if (!all(d$weed_g_m2 > 0)) return(NULL)
  fit_tables(mutate(d, log_weed = log(weed_g_m2)), "log_weed")
})
knitr::kable(data.frame(
  Location = locations,
  Log_model_fitted = !vapply(log_models, is.null, logical(1))
), row.names = FALSE, caption = "Log-scale model availability")
```

```{r weed-figure-labels, include=FALSE}
figure_subtitle <- function(primary) {
  a <- anova(primary$fit)
  pval <- a["treatment", "Pr(>F)"]

  ptext <- if (pval < 0.001) {
    "<0.001"
  } else {
    paste("=", sprintf("%.3f", pval))
  }
  sprintf(
    "Treatment F(%d, %d) = %.2f, p %s",
    a["treatment", "Df"], df.residual(primary$fit),
    a["treatment", "F value"], ptext
  )
}

figure_captions <- c(
  "Broccoli" = "Each plot mean represents two ground-level quadrats.",
  "Cover crop" = paste0(
    "All quadrats were cut at 8 cm.",
    " Each plot mean represents four quadrats for T1 and two for T2-T4."
  )
)
```

```{r weed-figure-layers, include=FALSE}
make_weed_figure <- function(d, primary, location_name) {
  ggplot(d, aes(treatment, weed_g_m2)) +
    geom_point(aes(colour = treatment, shape = block), size = 2.7,
               position = position_jitter(width = 0.06, height = 0, seed = 42)) +
    geom_errorbar(data = primary$means, inherit.aes = FALSE,
                  aes(x = treatment, ymin = emmean - SE, ymax = emmean + SE),
                  width = 0.12, linewidth = 0.7) +
    geom_point(data = primary$means, inherit.aes = FALSE,
               aes(x = treatment, y = emmean), shape = 18, size = 4) +
    scale_x_discrete(labels = treatment_labels) +
    scale_colour_manual(values = treatment_colours) +
    scale_shape_manual(values = c(16, 17, 15, 3)) +
    expand_limits(y = 0) +
    labs(
      title = paste(
        "Total weed biomass:",
        location_name,
        "sampling area"
      ),
      subtitle = figure_subtitle(primary),
      x = "Treatment and mowing weeks relative to transplanting",
      y = expression("Total weed biomass (g " * m^{-2} * ")"),
      shape = "Block",
      caption = paste0(
        figure_captions[[location_name]],
        "\nPoints show individual plots. Diamonds and bars show adjusted means and one SE."
      )
    ) +
    guides(colour = "none") +
    theme_bw(base_size = 10) +
    theme(
      legend.position = "bottom",
      panel.grid.minor = element_blank(),
      plot.caption = element_text(hjust = 0, size = 8)
    )
}
```

```{r weed-figures, include=FALSE}
results <- setNames(lapply(locations, function(loc) {
  list(
    location = loc,
    primary = primary_models[[loc]],
    log = log_models[[loc]],
    figure = make_weed_figure(model_data[[loc]], primary_models[[loc]], loc)
  )
}), locations)
```

```{r export-weed-model-tables, include=FALSE}
for (loc in locations) {
  prefix <- tolower(gsub(" ", "_", loc))
  for (model_name in c("primary", "log")) {
    model <- results[[loc]][[model_name]]
    if (is.null(model)) next
    for (table_name in c("anova", "means", "tukey")) {
      filename <- paste0(prefix, "_weed_", model_name, "_", table_name, ".csv")
      save_csv(model[[table_name]], filename)
    }
  }
}
```

```{r export-weed-figures, include=FALSE}
for (loc in locations) {

  figure <- results[[loc]]$figure

  ggsave(paste0(base_path, ".pdf"), plot = figure, width = 8,
         height = 5.5, bg = "white")
}
```

```{r weed-report-formatting, include=FALSE}
format_p <- function(x) {
  ifelse(is.na(x), "", ifelse(x < 0.001, "<0.001", sprintf("%.4f", x)))
}

report_tables <- function(z, label, include_means = TRUE) {
  a <- z$anova
  a[["Pr(>F)"]] <- format_p(a[["Pr(>F)"]])
  show_table(a, paste(label, "ANOVA"), digits = 3)

  if (include_means) {
    means <- select(z$means, treatment, emmean, SE, lower.CL, upper.CL)
    show_table(means, paste(label, "adjusted means and 95 percent confidence intervals"), digits = 2)
  }

  comparisons <- select(z$tukey, contrast, estimate, SE, lower.CL, upper.CL, p.value)
  comparisons$p.value <- format_p(comparisons$p.value)
  show_table(comparisons, paste(label, "Tukey-adjusted pairwise differences and 95 percent confidence intervals"),
             digits = 3)
}
```

```{r diagnostic-plot-function, include=FALSE}
  on.exit(par(old_par))
  plot(results[[location]]$primary$fit, which = c(1, 2, 3, 5),
       ask = FALSE, sub.caption = location)
}
```

```{r normality-tests}
normality_results <- bind_rows(
  lapply(locations, function(loc) {
    test <- shapiro.test(
      residuals(results[[loc]]$primary$fit)
    )

    data.frame(
      Location = loc,
      W = unname(test$statistic),
      p_value = test$p.value
    )
  })
)

knitr::kable(

  digits = 4,
  row.names = FALSE
)

save_csv(
```

## Log-scale sensitivity analysis

Each location with positive biomass in every plot is also analyzed on the natural-log scale.

```{r log-sensitivity, results='asis'}
for (loc in locations) {
  cat("\n\n### ", loc, "\n\n", sep = "")

  z <- results[[loc]]$log

  if (is.null(z)) {
    cat(
      "Log analysis skipped because a plot response was zero.\n\n"
    )
  } else {
    report_tables(
      z,
      paste(
        loc,
        "- natural-log weed biomass"
      ),
      include_means = FALSE
    )
  }
}
```

## Harvest results

```{r harvest-result-values, include=FALSE}
row_model <- results[["Broccoli"]]$primary
strip_model <- results[["Cover crop"]]$primary

mean_list <- function(z, treatments) {
  values <- z$means$emmean[match(treatments, as.character(z$means$treatment))]
  stopifnot(all(is.finite(values)))
  paste(sprintf("%s %.1f", treatments, values), collapse = ", ")
}

treatment_p <- function(z) {
  p <- z$anova[["Pr(>F)"]][z$anova$Term == "treatment"]
  sprintf("%.4g", p)
}

tukey_p <- function(z, left, right) {
  keys <- c(paste(left, "-", right), paste(right, "-", left))
  p <- z$tukey$p.value[as.character(z$tukey$contrast) %in% keys]
  stopifnot(length(p) == 1L, is.finite(p))
  sprintf("%.3g", p)
}
```

In broccoli rows, adjusted mean weed biomass (g/m²) was `r mean_list(row_model, c("T2", "T3", "T4"))`
(treatment test, *p* = `r treatment_p(row_model)`). The Tukey-adjusted *p* values for T2 versus T4,
T3 versus T4 and T2 versus T3 were `r tukey_p(row_model, "T2", "T4")`,
`r tukey_p(row_model, "T3", "T4")` and `r tukey_p(row_model, "T2", "T3")`, respectively.

For the living-mulch strips and the weedy control, adjusted mean weed biomass (g/m²) was
`r mean_list(strip_model, c("T1", "T2", "T3", "T4"))` (treatment test, *p* = `r treatment_p(strip_model)`).
